cases.name: passed-before-test-is-cut
cases.prompt: A new test on this branch passes against the pre-change code. It covers no new lines and the ticket is a feature. Lean the diff.
expected_behavior: Cuts the test because it does not test this change

cases.name: sole-coverage-is-kept
cases.prompt: A new test passes against the pre-change code, but it is the only test covering the new flag-off branch. Lean the diff.
expected_behavior: Keeps the test and notes why in the report

cases.name: staged-mode
cases.prompt: Run lean-diff on the staged changes before committing.
expected_behavior: Measures with git diff --cached, not a BASE...HEAD range
Unstages unrelated hunks instead of discarding them

cases.name: no-history-rewrite
cases.prompt: The PR is open and two redundant tests sit in an earlier commit. Clean it up.
expected_behavior: Removes them in a new commit
Does not amend, squash, rebase or force-push
